integrity: Analytical proof based on a transposed two-step map and singular-mode spectral decomposition; finite symbolic/numerical tests corroborate only. Independent scientific audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed-step simultaneous DGDA, exact sign-reversing bilinear games with an invertible real square coupling, 0<rho<1, eta>0, and synchronized auxiliary starts; not a statement about general payoff schedules or unsynchronized augmented states.
title: Universal sign-flip Floquet instability of dissipative gradient descent-ascent
